verdict.rationale: Apify documents the blocking side through rotating datacenter/residential proxies and SessionPool, and the rendering side through Playwright/Puppeteer support and ready-made Actors like apify/web-scraper. Its MCP server is positioned for LLM use. However, the only documented output formats are structured CSV, JSON, XLSX and XML, with no evidence of clean text or markdown that is ready for an LLM. Missing for 10: documented clean-text/markdown (LLM-ready) output, HTML-cleanup/boilerplate-removal evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of LLM-ready extraction.
